name: Legacy of Kain Soul Reaver 1&2 Remastered - Deluxe Edition
summary:
Celebrate Soul Reaver’s 25th anniversary and experience the epic conflict of Kain and Raziel in original form or with remastered graphics!

Beyond the physical game Legacy of Kain Soul Reaver 1&2 Remastered on Nintendo Switch or PlayStation 5, the Deluxe Edition includes the following exclusive items:
• Steelbook with some of the game’s gorgeous motifs.
• A soft bound artbook highlighting the game’s stunning remastered gothic environments, architecture, characters, enemies, weapons, and concept & key art.
• The Official Soundtrack on a physical CD.
• A collectible tuck-in box housing all the contents.
Included Game Titles:
• Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
• Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2
Game Features:

• Experience the Legendary Narrative: Centuries after your former master, Kain, betrays and executes you, you rise again and embark on a relentless quest for revenge.
• Wield the Powers of a Wraith: Slay your former vampire brethren with your claws, bolts of telekinetic energy, and the elemental Wraith Blade. Grow stronger by devouring the souls of your enemies.
• Shift Between Realms: The Elder God has granted you the ability to shift between the Spectral and Material Realms. Traverse the realms to solve puzzles, reveal new paths, and defeat your foes.
